maya: Heads-up — PR #68888 touches eviction metrics wiring + telemetry tagging. Need a small squad to own the reviews and the canary rollout. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pull/68888. Runtime vs platform vs infra vs security touchpoints all in play. CC @sam @leo @tariq. Who can own merge window and canary? Also need security sign-off on the new auth header addition.
sam: I can take runtime review but will need perf numbers (p95, p99) — can someone share benchmark command/config? :eyes:
leo: infra can own rollout + staging run. I can run the staging job and watch memory/eviction graphs. Late tonight canary works for me (i'm on-call tomorrow).
tariq: pinging security. We'll need a quick threat-model check for the header + KMS usage. ETA ~4h for a short scan.
maya: Thanks. Sam — try: `./bench/run.sh --workload eviction --samples 1000 --report p50,p95,p99` and paste results. Also include cold-start seq len 512. Add e2e flag if you can.
sam: Will run and post results here. FYI there's a small proto change under pkg/eviction; shouldn't break compat but adding note in changelog.
ci-bot: ci-bot: CI passed on main; integration job failed in staging: `tests/integration/eviction_test.go` exited 1 — memory spike observed in logs. See: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/68888/logs. cc @leo
leo: saw the staging failure. I'll reproduce and probably bump memory limit for the canary slot, and rerun integration.
maya: Proposed plan: sam does runtime review + perf by EOD, leo owns infra canary and memory tweak, tariq does security quick-scan. If green, merge in next merge window at 02:00 UTC tonight. :thumbsup:
sam: running bench now, will drop numbers in this thread when done.
tariq: quick scan complete — no auth issues but please add an audit log entry for header changes (one-line in CHANGELOG + note in security.md). Will LGT M after that.
maya: Great. Assigning owners: @sam (runtime), @leo (infra/canary), @tariq (security). Thanks all — i'll coordinate the merge window and update the PR with the plan. :shipit:
